title: AI for Service Management and Support

questions.question: What must AI support automation preserve?
options: Service ownership, escalation criteria, and support quality
questions.explanation: AI support should reduce friction without hiding accountability or service risk.

questions.question: Which signal is explicitly part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: SLA pressure is a service-management signal.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked support AI readiness plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact helps choose controls for support workflows.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
When should service AI require stronger controls?
options: When ticket volume, SLA pressure, or escalation risk is high
Only when the ticket text is short
Only when no users are affected
Never; support automation is always safe
questions.explanation: High-impact service workflows need stronger readiness controls.

questions.question: Why are confidence thresholds useful?
options: They prevent silent automation failure and trigger review or escalation
questions.explanation: Confidence thresholds keep uncertain cases in controlled paths.
